messages.text: I can't get your stratum address to work
I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Let me get the exact pool details for you.
Searched the web · HeliumDeploy Harlo pool stratum address port
Checking our pool page for the exact stratum details.

Here is what the Harlo Pool settings should be:

1. Stratum URL: `stratum+tcp://pool.harlolabs.com` and port `8888`
2. Worker / user: your Bitcoin Cash address
3. Password: `x`

The most common reason it will not connect: most miner UIs (Bitaxe, NerdQaxe, Hammer, Harlo OS) want the host and the port in two separate fields, and the host field must be just `pool.harlolabs.com`, with no `stratum+tcp://` in front and no `:8888` on the end. If you pasted the whole line from the page into one box, that alone will fail.

Two things so I can pin it down:

1. Which miner is it, and what firmware is on it?
2. What exactly does the UI or the screen say when it fails (connection refused, timeout, "authorization failed", or just no shares)?
